name: Replica Storyboard Localization
description: Localize accepted source shot facts directly into a Chinese-reviewable target storyboard with target-language dialogue and Chinese dialogue translations.
when_to_use: REPLICA has a CURRENT SOURCE_VIDEO_SNAPSHOT and needs the target-localized shot table
when_not_to_use: Source snapshot is missing or stale
The request is only script translation without shot structure

steps.title: 读取正式原片分镜
steps.description: Read frozen shot facts, stable identities and canonical dialogue from the current source snapshot.

steps.title: 规划人物与场景
steps.description: Read all episodes and freeze one coherent target world, full character designs, family relationships, settings and cultural props before rewriting any shots.

steps.title: 逐镜本土化
steps.description: Rewrite each shot using the frozen target world and server-bound entity definitions, and plan an independent target duration while retaining source timing as provenance.

provider_rules: Plan the complete target world across all episodes before any shot batch; redesign character appearance, wardrobe, names, family relationships, housing, furnishings and cultural props for target_language and target_region
Target language does not determine ethnicity; do not force one ethnicity or automatically retain source ethnicity and surnames
Freeze complete entity definitions and global continuity rules; shot batches consume the same full plan and never redesign entities
Names, family relationships, addresses, room layouts and currency choices must agree across entity definitions, visual prose and dialogue
Source visuals describe story action and composition, not mandatory target actor appearance or decor
Exact-cover all source shots and canonical dialogue IDs in shot rewriting; PLAN_WORLD reads all shots as context but returns no shots or dialogue
Visual and camera review descriptions must be Simplified Chinese
Spoken dialogue must be in target_language and each line must include a Simplified Chinese review translation
Plan target_duration_ms for every target shot from localized action, camera rhythm and dialogue; source timing is provenance, not the target duration
Every localized spoken line must fit the newly planned target shot at no more than 4 words per second or 6 CJK characters per second
Do not leave dialogue timing repair or acceleration to H3 Prompt Skill
Do not change shot order, source shot identity or source camera facts
Do not generate asset images or video prompts
completion_criteria: Every source shot is represented exactly once
Every canonical dialogue line is localized exactly once
Every target shot has an independently planned positive duration
Every target spoken line passes the target-window timing preflight
Target entity IDs are server-owned and traceable
failure_policy: Missing/duplicate shot or dialogue coverage fails the whole candidate
A target shot duration that cannot contain its assigned dialogue fails the candidate before review
Provider cannot publish CURRENT without explicit review
